english.note: Use 感覺 as the all-purpose noun for a physical sensation or subjective impression.

exampleSentences.english: The feeling I get from touching this shirt is very soft.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我摸呢件衫，感覺好柔軟。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 mo2 nei1 gin6 saam1 gam2 gok3 hou2 jau4 jyun5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physical feeling or perception.

exampleSentences.english: My hand is numb, so I can barely feel any sensation.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 maa4 bei3 mou5 mat1 gam2 gok3

english.note: Use this for ordinary, subjective sensory perception rather than the technical process of processing sensory information.

exampleSentences.english: My perception of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy tastes is very sensitive.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對甜酸苦辣嘅感覺好敏銳。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 tim4 syun1 fu2 laat6 ge3 gam2 gok3 hou2 man5 jeoi6
